Day and night humidity compares mean relative humidity for 06–17 UTC and the remaining hours. Use it when an agent needs a fixed-clock diurnal comparison.

Historical dew point returns hourly estimates from DWD air temperature and relative humidity. Use it when an agent needs dated dew points for a German site.
Historical humidity returns the minimum and maximum relative humidity with their UTC observation times. Use it when an agent needs the observed wettest and driest hours.
Sunshine variability returns the greatest positive increase from one reported hour to the next. Use it when an agent needs the sharpest brightening.
Observed sunshine counts sunless, intermittent and full-sun hourly buckets. Use it when an agent needs the mix of measured hourly sunshine regimes.
Sunshine accumulation locates the hour at which half the observed sunshine total had been received. Use it when an agent needs a sunshine-weighted midpoint.
Sunshine persistence returns the longest uninterrupted run of hours meeting a minimum sunshine duration. Use it when an agent needs the most persistent bright period.
Sunshine timing returns the first and last UTC hourly buckets with positive sunshine. Use it when an agent needs the extent of the observed sunny interval.
Sunshine duration returns accumulated measured sunshine minutes and hours from the nearest reporting station. Use it when an agent needs a historical observed total.
Historical rainfall distribution returns the millimetres recorded in each six-hour UTC time band. Use it when an agent needs intraday rainfall timing. German station observations, DWD CC BY 4.0.

Historical rainfall intensity returns the median positive hourly depth and the number of contributing hours. Use it when an agent needs typical intensity during wet periods. German station observation

Historical rain spells return the largest accumulated water depth of an uninterrupted positive-rainfall event. Use it when an agent needs the dominant storm volume within a window. German station obse
Historical dry weather returns the longest consecutive interval of measured zero precipitation. Use it when an agent needs a dry access window. German station observations, DWD CC BY 4.0.
Historical rainfall events count uninterrupted spells at or above a wet-hour threshold. Use it when an agent needs the number of separate wet spells. German station observations, DWD CC BY 4.0.
Historical precipitation returns the hourly observed depths in millimetres over a UTC date window. Use it when an agent needs an hourly rainfall record. German station observations, DWD CC BY 4.0.
Weather wind consistency returns the vector-mean bearing and persistence relative to mean speed. Use it when an agent needs to tell variable wind directions from a stable prevailing flow. Derived MET
Rain timing returns the first hourly forecast at or above a selected precipitation amount. Use it when an agent needs to locate the start of a modeled precipitation event. Derived MET Norway forecast
River level change returns the oldest and latest readings and their signed change. Use it when an agent needs to measure the observed direction and rate across a bounded reading window.
River gauge records return the historical minimum and maximum stage observations and dates. Use it when an agent needs to compare a station reading with its recorded extrema.
River gauge measures return available instrument identifiers, quantities, units and intervals. Use it when an agent needs to choose the correct reading series for a station.
Earthquake epicenter separation returns the farthest pair of events in the selected area. Use it when an agent needs to measure the observed spatial extent.
Earthquake hourly activity returns the UTC hour containing the most event origins and its count. Use it when an agent needs to find the peak reporting window.
Earthquake depth quartiles return the middle half of observed focal depths in kilometers. Use it when an agent needs to compare the depth range across locations.
